description:
Story 2 of fz-kdt.69's v2 design (parent is binding; fz-kdt.69.1 landed).

## The change
A reached-but-unresolved callsite today emits NOTHING -- and 'unresolved' is
conflated with 'provider boundary' as absence (CallTargetEdge.activation ==
None means boundary; no summary at all means unresolved). unknown-is-not-none,
literally: give the edge a third state, distinct in the VALUE MODEL, and emit
CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets for EVERY callsite the walk reaches, resolved
or not. Omission stops carrying meaning for these two kinds.

## Rip-out (same commit, owner law)
- The CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets arms of preserved_analysis_claims
  (world.rs) -- with total emission there is nothing to preserve.
- Any consumer branch that inferred 'unresolved' from absence.
- Doc text describing summary-omission semantics.

## Hazards
- Sweep ALL consumers of CallSiteSummary/CallSiteTargets (runtime_demand.rs
  ~917-921, artifact/native materializers, dispatch, diagnostics): the
  unresolved value must never read as boundary or as empty-type. Settledness
  guarantees resolution before consumers act on settled facts -- an
  UNRESOLVED summary that reaches a settled gate is a new representable
  state; decide and document what each consumer does (likely: unresolved at
  settlement = the callsite is dead code or an error -- find the truth, don't
  guess).
- Re-emitting unresolved each run must not bump revisions (define equality);
  unresolved -> resolved IS a content change and must wake readers.
- kdt.63 ratchet lifecycle rows for these two kinds WILL move (more distinct
  facts: previously-silent callsites now publish; retractions 24/0/77 -> 0).
  Re-pin with attribution -- pre-authorized for THESE two kinds only.
  Activation-kind rows must NOT move (Story 3's). Inventory pins 59/221/214
  and byte-identical backend MUST hold (move = STOP: the value model leaked
  into typing).

## Acceptance
- RED first: a reached-unresolved callsite publishes a summary whose value is
  distinct from a provider-boundary edge (test the value model directly);
  preservation of these kinds measured 0 after.
- True-preservation events for these kinds: 24/0/77 -> 0 (probe method in
  parent).
- Zero-uncaused unweakened; determinism suite; matrix; full fresh gates.
title: Every reached callsite publishes an edge, resolved or not
